sections.title: Ramanathaswamy Temple
sections.description: Ramanathaswamy Temple is one of the most important pilgrimage destinations in India and a major attraction in Rameswaram. Dedicated to Lord Shiva, the temple is renowned for its magnificent corridors, carved pillars, towering gopurams and religious significance.

sections.title: Pamban Bridge
sections.description: Pamban Bridge is one of the best-known landmarks associated with Rameswaram. The sea bridge connects the island region with mainland Tamil Nadu and offers a striking coastal setting.

sections.title: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial
sections.description: The Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial honours India's former President and renowned scientist, who was born in Rameswaram. The memorial is an interesting stop for families, students and visitors who want to learn more about his life, achievements and contributions to science and public service.
